root_cause: A previously never-merged superseded PR #4686 contains the same migration filename as the protected merged successor #4697, but its older source blob differs; current terminal closure unconditionally rejects any retired migration regardless of authoritative replacement.
fix: Allow a closed unmerged predecessor only when every proposed migration path is identically present in the CURRENT protected merged terminal successor and the checked-out source; still demand verified migration APPLIED provider readback for terminal successor.
prevention_rule: Check exact predecessor/successor path lineage before expensive closure replay. Never silently drop a migration absent from the merged terminal PR, unknown migration version, open predecessor, unknown runtime, missing provider APPLIED record or mismatched tenant/security proof.
